properties.message_511: On I-95 at mile marker 78.8 in the City of Richmond, motorists can expect delays due to a disabled vehicle. The south right shoulder is closed.
On Rt. 644 East in the County of Fairfax, in the vicinity of Carrleigh Pkwy; Rt. 4131E (Fairfax County), motorists can expect delays due to an incident. Lane closures exist.
